Paragraph: "He that righteous Sugreeva considering his own strength and weakness is much agitated, and along with all the other monkeys too are frightened..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Evaluating relative strengths and weaknesses under high stress leads to collective group panic.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva conducts a rapid threat assessment, realizing his weakness, and his fear spreads to his counselors.
Outcome/Resolution: A state of shared panic develops across the entire group.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Vimarsa (Critically weighing capabilities vs. threats under stress)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Relying purely on egoic strength and physical calculation leads to fear when facing greater forces.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Threat appraisal and emotional contagion: recognizing one's vulnerability amplifies distress and infects surrounding peers.
